searches.finding: No direct selected product record found. One soy-sauce hit is rice with raw egg and 2 g soy sauce; a mixed meal is not the sauce GI.

searches.source: University of Sydney public GI search
searches.finding: No fish-sauce match. Soy sauce appears in a rice/egg meal. Broth matches are noodle meals or legume broths, not these stocks. This bounded search does not prove no study exists anywhere.

searches.source: Atkinson et al. 2023 randomised crossover trial
searches.finding: 11 healthy adults; meal includes rice, peas and 10 g Kikkoman plus test drink. The meal GI cannot be assigned to Kikkoman alone.

rejectedShortcuts: A sugar line equal to the carbohydrate line is not proof that all sugars are sucrose.
A fermented sauce is not nutritionally equivalent to the unfermented soybean or wheat.
The vegetable GI-40 imputation was not extended to filtered broth or fermented sauce without an applicability decision.
Generic web GI 0/25/50/57.6 without a corresponding primary food test was not adopted.
No hypothetical GI including 100 or 150 is a physiological maximum.

alternativeProducts.decision: Not selected: ingredient/market/version differences and Finnish retailer conflict prevent mixing these records. No claim that the FI page is necessarily the current physical pack.

labelDefinitionSource.decision: Preserve declared EU carbohydrate separately from the prototype definition excluding polyols. Missing fibre is not zero; zero labels and equality of rounded values are not exact chemical identities.

approvalScope: Whole batch review of four product references, eight recipe binding proposals and consumption assumptions. It does not approve an overall GK, earlier run-2 imputation, production changes or publication.
